text:
maria: Quick heads-up — i'm doing a sweep of the Optimize toolkit docs for batching/caching/quant profiles. Found a couple stale SDK snippets and one broken internal link in the migration guide (PR #4321). Will open small PRs, but need quick owners to verify runtime snippets and run the playground smoke tests. aiming for EOD today.

kevin: @maria please drop the exact file paths, i can update both node + python snippets.

maria: paths i saw: docs/optimize/recipes/batching.md, docs/optimize/snippets/cache-prefetch.md, docs/optimize/migration/quant-profiles.md — the node example in cache-prefetch still uses old client call.

kevin: got it. i'll replace the old call with the new SDK brevity pattern. example i'll push: 

```js
// node snippet for prefix caching
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const resp = await client.optimize.generate({
  model: 'redwood/fast-v1',
  input: 'summarize: ...',
  optimize: { batchSize: 4, cachePrefix: true }
});
console.log(resp.text);
```

sam: i can run the smoke on the perf playground after you push. will check latency and that kv-prefetch actually reduces token execs.

anya: quick note on quant naming — migration doc references "quant-lite" which we've standardized to "q4_0" in the model catalog. need to update the examples and add a short mapping table, e.g. 

```
# quant profile mapping (for migration doc)
quant-lite -> q4_0
quant-std  -> q5_0
quant-hq   -> q8_0
```

maria: nice. can you draft that mapping and the one-sentence rationale line? also add a small warning about base-model changes impacting perf.

anya: will do, pushing a tiny paragraph and the table now.

kevin: pushed node snippet update in my branch + a minor README fix. left a comment on the python example — it still uses client.optimize.run(...) which is deprecated.

maria: thanks. @sam can you run the playground check and post results here? i want to confirm that batchSize 4 vs 8 tradeoffs in the docs are still accurate.

sam: running now. command i use for the smoke: 

```bash
# local smoke run for optimize playground
python -m redwood.optimize_smoke --profile q4_0 --batch 4 --warmup 2
```

sam: quick results: batch 4 median latency 180ms/token, batch 8 median latency 220ms/token but throughput +1.9x. prefix caching reduces repeated token work by ~35% on our test set. attaching short log excerpt.

kevin: good numbers. i'll update the batching.md paragraph to show the latency/throughput tradeoff and include sam's numbers with a note saying "results will vary by model/seq-length".

maria: also spotted a 404 in migration/quant-profiles.md linking to internal bench notes — docs-bot, can you rerun linkcheck for that subtree?

.docs-bot: Linkcheck report: 1 broken link found in docs/optimize/migration/quant-profiles.md -> /internal/bench/q4_0-results (404). Action: mark for removal or replace with public summary.

maria: thanks. decision: remove the internal link and replace with a short public summary paragraph + reference to the catalog entry. i'll draft the paragraph and push to the PR.

anya: pushed the quant-name mapping + rationale. also added a tiny migration note: "if you see regression after quant migration, try q5_0 and compare eval prompts before rolling out."

kevin: updated python snippet and fixed an import path. sample i'll use in docs: 

```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.optimize.generate(model='redwood/fast-v1', input='...', optimize={'batch_size':8, 'kv_prefetch':True})
print(resp.output)
```

maria: excellent. i'll open a single PR that aggregates kevin's snippet fixes + anya's mapping + my removal of the internal link + a short note in batching.md with sam's numbers. Please review quickly when i ping the PR.

sam: reviewed locally, leaving one nit in batching phrasing. will comment in PR. :eyes:

kevin: will review after lunch. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — appreciate the quick sweep. i'll tag everyone in the PR and request approvals. if anyone is blocked on reproducing numbers, ping me here and i'll share the playground snapshot.

sam: not blocked, thanks.

kevin: thanks!

docs-bot: PR opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4475 — includes snippets, mapping table, and linkfix. CI: linkcheck + snippet-lint + unit tests queued.
